label: Closed-collection controls, checked
description: Controls for the batch. The limit grounder shows the closed-collection condition is strictly weaker than AGWF, does not give J2 even with reflexive access and no-novel-edge, and is jointly satisfiable with the premises of the coverage routes; it also shows ascent along a grade with a maximum is compatible with infinite ascent, so the grade maximum does not give no infinite ascent. The pure regress is an omission countermodel for the closed-collection condition in the from-necessity coverage routes. The rooted cycle shows it does not give asymmetry, and with reflexive access and no-novel-edge does not exclude mutual support between necessary concreta. The point witness shows the attenuation bridge is satisfiable (without a grounding edge). Model-witnessed only; no interpretation is claimed metaphysically possible.
